Innovive partners with trusted distributors worldwide to bring our products and services to research labs around the world. Our shipping and logistics network ensures our products arrive safely and on time.

While we seek to continuously our reach, below is a view of where we currently sell and distribute product.

Beyond North America, Innovive maintains long-standing relationships with established distributors in Asia, Oceania, the Americas, and the Middle East. Each partner is vetted for technical proficiency, logistics capability, and on-the-ground service so research teams receive the same standard of support, anywhere.
Innovive also offers direct sales in Europe, no regional distributor required.
